answer_1.quote: We focus on extractive summarization of lengthy documents, including both written documents and transcripts of spoken language.

answer_2.quote: Standard evaluation metrics (ROUGE; , including R-1, R-2 and R-L, are used to measure the quality of system summaries.

answer_4.quote: We performed evaluation using Amazon Mechanical Turk on 100 randomly selected summarization instances from arXiv. We recruited Masters turkers to work on our task.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators judge the relevance of each sentence for informativeness on a scale of 1 to 5 and assess if each sentence offers new content for diversity.
